before: In compatibility mode 15 and later, one right-to-left run turned off space compression beside floating objects for its whole left-to-right paragraph.
after: Those paragraphs compress their spaces in each passage beside a floating object, as paragraphs without right-to-left runs do. Right-to-left paragraphs keep their existing behavior. A space after a right-to-left word that ends a passage stays in that passage.
reason: Only local line breaks and span geometry change. Canonical OOXML, offsets, operations, and collaboration data remain unchanged, and every peer derives the same layout from the same document.
